en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing an ornate doorway of a historic palazzo. The entrance is framed by two sculpted figures acting as caryatids or atlantes on either side of the door, with stone columns beneath them. Above is an iron balcony with decorative railing and shuttered windows. The facade has rusticated stonework and a small, grilled window to the left. Printed captions identify the scene as the gate of Palazzo Larcher in Trento, and the left margin bears the printer's information.
